set.body:
Integrate admitted modules into build.sbt aggregates and compileAll/testAll, README module blurbs, docs/module-relations.md, and a dedicated docs/surface-viewer.md. Provide JVM JavaFX and Scala.js examples using the same GIFTI fixture and declarative layer/view model, including scalar thresholds, labels, bilateral orientation, picking, snapshots, and performance receipts. Document backend capabilities, JavaFX atlas design and limits, browser comparison method, coordinate conventions, topology identity, resource lifecycle, and troubleshooting.

Final release gate: focused JVM/JS/core/backend suites; testAll; warning-clean compilation; deterministic reference fixtures; live JavaFX and browser visual receipts; benchmark JSON checked into the designated docs/benchmarks location; no undocumented caveats; no unrelated dirty-tree files staged. The epic closes only after the examples reproduce equivalent semantic receipts on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Surface viewer integration, examples, documentation, and release gate
